name: Semerarete ~Onna Tenchou~
source:
Main character works part-time as a florist. It's a very hard work, but he can't quit as he needs this money. One day he masturbates alone in the shop. His female manager gets furious upon witnessing it, so punishment game is organized.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家花店兼职。工作十分辛苦，但他需要这份收入，无法辞职。某天，他独自在店里自慰。女店长目睹后勃然大怒，于是为他安排了一场惩罚游戏。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
